detail: max diff 0.0083; s=1 RowParallel path green

watcher NoC alignment assert on a 32-byte DRAM read = the ROW_MAJOR gamma face-1 read at +16 elements. Blackhole DRAM alignment is 64, so only element offsets t*32 are legal; fix = read the whole 32-element chunk to tile byte 0 and relocate the face-1 half with a local L1->L1 copy (L1 align 16).

RM+gamma had gamma silently dropped. Diagnosis: PackTile with TileOffset::Unset emits pack_tile<out_of_order_output=false>, which ignores out_idx and uses an internal sequential counter; the reconfig fold elides the pack reconfig for a second chain packing to the SAME CB, so the counter never rewinds. Fix: TileOffset::Set (base 0) on the in-place output -> pack_tile<true> honours base+i_flat.
